listings.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
listings.summary: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS) is an initiative by the Malaysian Government to attract top talents from around the world to pursue postgraduate studies in Malaysia. listings.name: Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP)
listings.funder_name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Malaysia (Wisma Putra)
listings.summary: The Malaysian Technical Cooperation Program (MTCP) was established in 1980 as Malaysia's contribution to the South-South Cooperation initiative.
